_about: Reviewed corrections to the vote-actions tagger (netlify/lib/vote-actions-core.ts TAG_CORRECTIONS). Per bill key: issue keys the text-derived tagger got clearly wrong (drop) or missed (add), with why. 'add' keys come from the reviewed measure issues (vr_measure_issues, curated) unless the note says otherwise. Applied after the text signals, for that bill only; an amendment with a correction keeps its own (corrected) tags and does not inherit its parent's. Edit by hand; a change takes effect on the next re-tag of that bill (bump TAGGER_VERSION to re-tag every stored bill). Reviewed 2026-11-21.

us-119-hr-1.why: The summary mentions the filibuster only to explain reconciliation procedure, and 'parents' only in the SNAP work-requirement section; neither is a topic of the act. The added keys are the act's reviewed component issues.

us-119-s-1582.why: GENIUS Act: judicial_check came only from the CRS subject 'Judicial review and appeals'; the act does not touch court power. Added the reviewed keys (the state/federal issuer regimes, tech guardrails).

us-119-hr-5334.why: Russia/Iran sanctions act: 'teacher' and 'early childhood' come from a tax-deduction rider for educator expenses, not school or child-care policy; immig_balance came only from the CRS subject on visa bans for sanctioned persons.

us-119-s-1383.why: S. 1383 was the Senate vehicle for the SAVE America Act: its summary and roll call are about proof of citizenship and photo ID to vote. Veterans and health care come from the shell bill's title and subjects; Social Security, military and citizenship words appear only as ID options and exemptions.

us-119-hr-4690.why: Repeals federal-building energy efficiency and fossil-fuel phase-out standards: 'efficiency' here is energy efficiency, not government-reform efficiency.
